description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJmsListener' that implements JMS message listening and exception handling for a messaging system within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles receiving messages, deserializing service contexts, invoking services, and managing JMS connection state.

classes.name: AbstractJmsListener
classes.description: An abstract JMS message listener class for handling service invocation and JMS exceptions within OFBiz.

methods.name: AbstractJmsListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dispatcher with the provided delegator.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Processes the incoming MapMessage to deserialize the service context and invoke the specified service.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming JMS messages; filters for MapMessage and triggers service run.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles JMS exceptions by attempting to reconnect.
